metadata.description: A curated collection of useful plugins for Claude Code

plugins.name: project-memory-updater
plugins.description: A plugin for managing CLAUDE.md configurations with auto-update detection

plugins.name: socratic-questioning
plugins.description: A plugin that guides Claude to use Socratic questioning methods with multiple choice questions to clarify unclear prompts

plugins.name: darwin
plugins.description: Automatic error-fixing plugin that offloads runtime error resolution to a dedicated agent, saving main conversation context

plugins.name: plan-guardian
plugins.description: Plan review workflow plugin with a plan-reviewer agent for rigorous plan quality checks. Non-blocking by default — Claude autonomously decides when to review, or users trigger via /plan-review. v1.3.0 adds an opt-out codex review gate: a PreToolUse:ExitPlanMode hook intercepts plan-mode exits, instructs Claude to run /plan-guardian:codex-plan-review which loops `codex exec` against the plan and revises it until Codex emits NO_CONCERNS (set CODEX_PLAN_REVIEW=0 to disable). v1.4.x consolidated the loop's writes into a pre-approvable plan-review-helper.sh + a /plan-guardian:setup command of scoped allow-rules. v1.5.0 replaces the on-disk sha256 sentinel with an INLINE review marker carried inside the plan text (`<!-- codex-reviewed:<token> -->` on the last line; a CODEX_REVIEW_SECRET-keyed sha256 of the plan body, literal fallback when unset). The loop now writes nothing to disk during plan mode — the proof rides through tool_input.plan — sidestepping the upstream bug where the allow-list intermittently fails to suppress Write/Edit prompts under mode toggles; setup now needs only two Bash allow-rules (codex exec + helper). v1.5.1 makes content-binding the default: the helper resolves the key as CODEX_REVIEW_SECRET if set, else a per-machine auto key file (~/.claude/plan-guardian/secret, generated on first use), else a literal fallback only when no key can be established — every user gets the content-bound marker with zero setup.

plugins.name: bug-fix-testcase
plugins.description: End-to-end bug fix workflow with /bugfix command: analyze, research, plan, fix + parallel test generation, merge, and verify

plugins.name: codex-cr-loop
plugins.description: Codex review loop commands with three completion modes (review-only stop, local merge, push + open PR). v1.7.0 review protocol: class-format findings (Pattern / Instances / Fix / Prevent — every instance, fixed in one pass) returned as schema-validated JSON (codex exec --output-schema; the verdict is never parsed from prose); round 1 reviews the whole branch diff, later rounds review only the diff since the last reviewed head; a per-branch no-repeat ledger (stable class ids, stored under .git, survives across invocations) is passed to every round; round cap CR_LOOP_ROUND_CAP=3 dirty rounds triggers a mandatory step-back round (recurring classes, approach change per class, prevention), then incremental rounds resume, and a second cap hit after CR_LOOP_MAX_STEP_BACKS=1 asks the user; recurring classes must be codified at the source (lint rule, source-guard test, or REVIEW.md entry). Converges on two consecutive clean rounds on the same HEAD, the second over the whole diff. Reviewer is codex exec (read-only sandbox, model_reasoning_effort=high, detached, stdin /dev/null) via scripts/cr-review.sh — no 1 MiB diff limit. Keeps the always-on interaction-logic guard, preflight base-currency gate, /cr-loop-pr auto-rebase + confirmation round, head-drift check, P3-skip default and the Chinese business-impact summary (3–8 lines, or the literal 无业务逻辑影响). Replaces the v1.6 widening guard / auto-widening sweep. v1.8.0: review rules (REVIEW.md / AGENTS.md / CLAUDE.md) are read from the review base commit, never the branch under review (codex runs with project_doc_max_bytes=0); the branch's rule-file edits are reviewed content — additions allowed, removed or rewritten rules return needs-human until a person approves them (ack-rules, fingerprint-bound); finish also catches HEAD moving away and back and uncommitted edits during a round. v1.8.1: atomic pending.tx recovery across all state writers (cr-tx.sh), persisted clean_streak + strict two-round/post-rebase convergence proof, .gitattributes-immune raw blob rule inspection (--no-relative/--no-abbrev), versioned fail-closed tree_fp v2 (including untracked files), post-convergence RECURRING scoping, strict JSON duplicate-key/additionalProperties validation, ps -ww runner check, bounded wait backoff, and /cr-loop-pr Step 8.0 base-update + pre-rebase pinned lease.

plugins.name: form-base
plugins.description: HTML interaction base for Claude Code & Codex: agent-emitted forms (radio/checkbox/text/markdown + color/font/slider), rich-response views (business-prominent, technical-collapsed), and a switchable SessionStart-injected communication role (product-manager default; developer / lawyer / null switchable via /form-base:role). Role shapes answers only, never restricts tool use.
